data.body:
Plan review BLOCK, correct on both findings — the same contradiction stated twice. AC1 offered 'or skips with a stated reason when the object is packed' while AC3 requires BOTH shapes exercised. A skip exercises nothing, so the escape hatch would have relocated the gap instead of closing it: on a packed store the fail-closed behaviour would still never run.

AC1 now requires the object be made unreadable on EACH shape by a route appropriate to it — delete the loose file when loose, remove the pack when packed — with no skip permitted.
